description:
`jit validate`, a read, leaves `.jit-bootstrap.lock` at the repository root, so a read writes a file into an adopter's tree.

## Background

Found running a read-only `jit validate` in `~/Projects/research`, which then showed `.jit-bootstrap.lock` as untracked. Reproduced on a fresh `git init` plus `jit init` with the lock removed: `jit validate` creates it and `jit query available` and `jit issue search` do not. This repository lists the file in its own `.gitignore`, but an adopter's does not. Validation's lock acquisition is at `crates/jit/src/storage/json.rs:664-680`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit validate` without `--fix` creates no file in the repository.
- [hard] REQ-02: A test owns REQ-01 on a repository with no lock file present.

## Notes

- `@/charter/D-22`: reads never wait on writers. If validation has a real need for the lock, report it before changing it.
title: jit validate leaves a bootstrap lock file in the repository
